post.description: Registers a new customer, enforces unique email and phone number, awards loyalty bonus points, and returns a 10-year access token.

message.example: Customer registered successfully
Please enter a valid email address
This phone number is already registered

post.description: Authenticates customer by email or phone and returns a 10-year access token containing embedded customer data and cart count.

message.example: Login successful
Incorrect password
No account found with these credentials

post.description: Generates a 6-digit OTP code with 10-minute expiry and sends it to the customer email address.

message.example: A 6-digit verification code has been sent to your email
No account found with this email address

post.description: Verifies the 6-digit OTP code against the hashed token and issues a short-lived resetToken for setting a new password.

message.example: OTP verified successfully
Invalid OTP. Please check the code and try again.

post.description: Updates customer password using the verified resetToken.

message.example: Password has been updated successfully. You can now login.
Password reset session has expired or is invalid. Please restart the process.
